svg.text: Server-side pagination · View vs Edit modes · Save pipeline · Document upload gate
1 · PAGE LOAD — first page + lookups delivered to the browser
2 · EVERY page / search / sort / filter — server-side loop via dataLoader
DOM never holds more than one page
3 · ROW EXPAND — two entry points, one data source: record[field.key]
⚠ KEY RULE — one name, three places
Select keys must be the numeric FK (…Id),
4 · SAVE — from inputs back to the database
wrap as { form: dto } ← param binding
5 · ADD NEW — document upload gates the insert
choose file → validate ext + MIME + size
Save LOCKED until upload returns a GUID
6 · ACTION BUTTONS — component fires, page routes, server acts
INTERNAL STATE — what the component tracks per row
_allData current page slice only (server-side mode) — never the whole dataset
_serverTotalCount true total from GetPage — drives the pager math
_editBuffer[id] deepClone draft — Cancel discards it, Save merges it into the record
_uploadState { file, guid, uploading, progress, error } — guid gates the insert
field.key the contract: must match the wire property name EXACTLY, everywhere
AccordionGrid v1.0.1 · zero dependencies · ASP.NET WebForms 4.8 · green arrows = data flowing back toward the UI
